# What the release tarball holds: one git pathspec per line, relative to the repository
# root. The `release` workflow reads this file; tests/test_release_files.py checks it.
#
# A file that is tracked but neither listed here nor in the workflow's NOT_SHIPPED
# pattern (.github/, tests/, pyproject.toml, .gitignore) fails the release, so a new
# font source or data file cannot be left out by accident.

# The front door, the manifest the tool reads, the licence and the instructions
Makefile
sources.json
LICENSE
README.md

# The tool: the whole package, with its non-Python data (fontcodesets/codesets.toml,
# otf2bdf/LICENSE)
tools/README.md
tools/psf_font_maker

# The tables the tool reads
data/AUTHORS.md
data/LICENSE.md
data/README.md
data/arabic.equivalents
data/standard.equivalents
data/ascii.set
data/linux.set
data/useful.set
data/faces.toml
data/codesets

# The fonts: each source directory whole, so that its LICENSE.md, AUTHORS.md and
# README.md travel with the fonts they describe
data/fontsets/sources.lock.json
data/fontsets/debian-legacy-fonts
data/fontsets/dejavu
data/fontsets/terminus-font
data/fontsets/ucs-fonts
data/fontsets/uni-vga
